passages.text: In our small town, children play football in the square after school. There are houses and shops nearby, so everyone keeps the ball away from the windows. Ben likes to kick the ball to a teammate instead of sending it towards a shop. A younger child wants to join, but she has no team yet. The older pupils invite her and make the teams the same size. She soon learns where to stand and who can help her. The square becomes a place where children of different ages play together.

parallelText.en: In our small town, children play football in the square after school.
parallelText.zh: 在我们的小镇里，孩子们放学后在广场踢足球。

parallelText.en: There are houses and shops nearby, so everyone keeps the ball away from the windows.
parallelText.zh: 附近有住宅和商店，所以大家让球远离窗户。

parallelText.en: Ben likes to kick the ball to a teammate instead of sending it towards a shop.
parallelText.zh: 本喜欢把球踢给队友，而不朝商店踢。

parallelText.en: A younger child wants to join, but she has no team yet.
parallelText.zh: 一个更小的孩子想加入，但她还没有队伍。

parallelText.en: The older pupils invite her and make the teams the same size.
parallelText.zh: 大孩子们邀请她，并让两队人数相同。

parallelText.en: She soon learns where to stand and who can help her.
parallelText.zh: 她很快学会站在哪里，以及谁可以帮助她。

parallelText.en: The square becomes a place where children of different ages play together.
parallelText.zh: 广场成了不同年龄的孩子共同玩耍的地方。

wordHelp.meaning: an open public place in a town
someone on the same team

passages.text: Sara and her father visit a sandy beach early in the morning. They leave the busy road and hear only waves and a few birds. The beach is peaceful before the crowds arrive. Sara sits on a dry rock and draws the lines that the water makes on the sand. Her father writes a few words about the sounds in a small notebook. They compare their notes and pictures before walking back to the bus stop. Both find that a quiet visit helps them notice things they usually miss.

parallelText.en: Sara and her father visit a sandy beach early in the morning.
parallelText.zh: 萨拉和爸爸清早来到一片铺满沙子的海滩。

parallelText.en: They leave the busy road and hear only waves and a few birds.
parallelText.zh: 他们离开繁忙的道路，只听见海浪和几只鸟的声音。

parallelText.en: The beach is peaceful before the crowds arrive.
parallelText.zh: 人群到来之前，海滩很安静。

parallelText.en: Sara sits on a dry rock and draws the lines that the water makes on the sand.
parallelText.zh: 萨拉坐在干燥的岩石上，画海水在沙上留下的线条。

parallelText.en: Her father writes a few words about the sounds in a small notebook.
parallelText.zh: 爸爸在小笔记本里写下几句关于声音的记录。

parallelText.en: They compare their notes and pictures before walking back to the bus stop.
parallelText.zh: 走回车站前，他们比较记录和画作。

parallelText.en: Both find that a quiet visit helps them notice things they usually miss.
parallelText.zh: 两人都发现，安静的游览帮助他们注意到平时忽略的细节。

wordHelp.meaning: rising and falling movements of water
